title: Greet by full name
description:
Read a person's **full name** (it may contain spaces) and greet them:

```
Hello, Ada Lovelace!
```

`std::cin >> name` stops at the first space, so it would only read "Ada". Use `std::getline` to read the whole line.
hints: `std::getline(std::cin, name);` reads everything up to the end of the line, spaces included.
rules: Use `std::getline` so names with spaces work.

rules.message: Use `std::getline` so names with spaces work.
